Welcome!
Would you like some Scratch-Off Cards?You may buy three Scratch-Off Cards
for {STRVAR_1 50, 0, 0} BP.Hidden on each Scratch-Off Card are
icons of Pokémon.You may scratch the obscuring film off 
a card three times.If the same icon appears three times,
you will win a prize, like a Berry.Also, DITTO’s icon can transform into
any other Pokémon.Good luck matching Pokémon icons!
